correctness.rationale: Unique occupied-component injections give the polynomial for all t,n, complement invariance is exact. Gardiner classification proves exhaustiveness, and explicit group stabilizer sums plus independent induced-type counts verify both exceptions. The deficiency distribution has monotone weight ratios and a uniform local Gaussian expansion with tail control; fixed-t conditional product coupling gives variance t/2. The standard Laguerre asymptotic gives the total-order constant.
